digest.component_or_area: completion verification test harness (LLM bedrock lane)
propositions: The test monkeypatch closure observed_upsert has a narrow signature (self, criterion_id, met, evidence, *, source='tool') that does not accept keyword-only parameters evidence_sufficient and seeded that the production CriterionBank.upsert now requires.

When verify_completion runs under the monkeypatch and the bounded-fallback path calls upsert(..., evidence_sufficient=False), the narrow stub raises TypeError: observed_upsert() got an unexpected keyword argument 'evidence_sufficient'.

The bedrock LLM arm triggers the bounded-fallback path in record_insufficient due to insufficient evidence, while anthropic/openai arms gather sufficient evidence and never call the fallback, explaining why the TypeError is bedrock-specific and not a live flakiness.

The fix threads all keyword arguments through the test stub by forwarding **kwargs to the real upsert, preserving the signal for evidence_sufficient, seeded, and future kwargs without altering production code.
A unit regression test was added to drive record_insufficient and seeded upsert through the shared wrapper to verify the kwargs are forwarded and the TypeError is eliminated.
